summary.text: Will Mbah is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 34th Middlesex District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served as an at-large city councilor in Somerville for nearly a decade.

paragraphs.text: Will Mbah earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Buea in 2005, a graduate degree from the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences in 2011, and a graduate degree from the Harvard Kennedy School in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he came to the United States from Cameroon sixteen years ago, holds a master's in public administration from the Harvard Kennedy School, and is raising two children in public schools with his wife.
Mbah was one of four winners of the 2019 nonpartisan general election for Somerville City Council At-large, according to Ballotpedia.

In the survey, he said he has served as an at-large city councilor and as the council's vice president, and that he helped create the Office of Housing Stability and the Somerville Community Land Trust.
In the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary for the 34th Middlesex District, which has no incumbent, he received 53.9 percent of the vote and defeated Paul Ruseau and Christopher Oates.
Mbah said in the survey that he is passionate about housing affordability and stability, workers' rights, climate and environmental sustainability, and transportation and infrastructure.
